import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_students = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_schools = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect loaded data (optional, can be commented out)
    # print(df_students.head())
    # print(df_schools.head())
    
    # Join condition: df_students.school_name == df_schools.school_name
    # This will bring school info (School ID, type, size, budget) into student records
    
    # Perform left join to keep all students and enrich with school info
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_students, df_schools, on="school_name", how="left")
    
    # Ensure columns are in the target schema order and types:
    # Target Schema: 
    # ['Student ID': int, 'student_name': str, 'gender': str, 'grade': str, 'school_name': str,
    #  'reading_score': int, 'math_score': int, 'School ID': int, 'type': str, 'size': int, 'budget': int]
    
    # Convert data types explicitly to match target schema
    # For numeric columns, fill missing values if any before conversion
    
    # Fill missing numeric values with 0 or appropriate default if needed
    # Here, assuming no missing Student ID or scores, but just in case:
    df_merged['Student ID'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['Student ID'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_merged['reading_score'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['reading_score'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_merged['math_score'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['math_score'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_merged['School ID'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['School ID'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_merged['size'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['size'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_merged['budget'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['budget'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # Convert string columns to string type explicitly
    str_columns = ['student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name', 'type']
    for col in str_columns:
        df_merged[col] = df_merged[col].astype(str)
    
    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = ['Student ID', 'student_name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school_name',
                      'reading_score', 'math_score', 'School ID', 'type', 'size', 'budget']
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]
    
    # Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_47/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
    print(f"Transformation complete. Output saved to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
